_meta.scenario: Admin-initiated system or operational cancellation that doesn't fit a specific sub-status — e.g., cancelled due to a system-level issue, safety concern, area restriction, or regulatory reason. Refund is triggered since it is Cabbo-side.
_meta.note: canceled_by_cabbo = true → full refund triggered. Use a specific sub-status (driver_no_show, driver_unavailable, etc.) wherever possible. Only fall back to 'other' when no other sub-status fits.
